findings.issue: Port 22 open to the world (0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0) in ingress rule
findings.recommendation: Restrict the CIDR to known IP ranges or use AWS Systems Manager Session Manager instead of exposing SSH/RDP.

findings.issue: S3 bucket ACL is set to "public-read" which allows broad access
findings.recommendation: Set acl to "private" and use bucket policies to grant least-privilege access.
